alerts.reason: September net sales grew 3.8% year over year, with firm U.S. chicken demand early in the quarter (A, B). That demand supports a forecast of sales growth above -5.00% in the intervening quarter. Excess supply had begun to pressure prices, and cold-storage inventories rose 4.3% in August (C). If that buildup keeps prices under pressure, consolidated net sales could fall at least 5.00% year over year in the quarter starting December 29.

September revenue rose about 1.1% year over year to $196.8 million as Power Products distribution gains outweighed weaker Materials demand (A). Those gains could keep intervening-quarter revenue growth above -5.00%. With product demand softening and prices under continued pressure in some applications (B), I forecast a year-over-year revenue decline of at least 5.00% in the quarter starting December 29.
